notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
The demo of Deep in the Forest has received an update, fixing some known issues (inventory sometimes generating bugs, malfunction in the potion making mini-game if you didn't have enough herbs for it).

We have also added Senan's introduction (the sixth love interest out of seven), and a few scenes so you can get to know the love interests and the village's daily life... before stuff starts to happen and shit hits the fan, hehehe! Enjoy the flirting while you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202403/a2a0b0a57cbccc3733589000821fbb406a043d75.png

notes.title: Change of release date
notes.content:
Hi! As many of you surely know, Ertal Games is currently working towards the release of another visual novel, Night and Day, so until the game is finally released Deep in the Forest's production is on hold. The release date we put on Steam was always meant to be a placeholder (although we really expected to make it in time; my sincere apologies for the delay).

That doesn't mean DitF is completely forgotten, far from it! Our character artist, Sinnia, is working on the two final love interests of the game, of which I can already show you one. And we'll update the demo with Senan's introduction and a bit more of the plot before this 2021 finishes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202403/1ac1b28afb0a3500b8b869ba08343234e24e19a0.png

So we can confidently announce that the definitive release date for Deep in the Forest is July 2022.

notes.title: Demo Final Update!
notes.content:
I guess the current demo is the definitive state of the start of the game... unless something major happens, of course!

What has been added?


 The fifth love interest, Ganter the Cheeky Knight (two guys more will appear in the full game).

 The second mini-game: let's make potions! So far, it's easy and more like a tutorial... but trust me, it will get difficult as the game progresses.

 Some small tweaks, like edits in the English text and more sounds added.


With Ganter finally in the game, we'll get a glimpse of the true plot of the story... or did you think picking up plants and flirting was all that Jan had to do? If so... think again!

Just in time for the Next Fest on Steam in June, by the way! If you like the game, help us win visibility by wishlisting it, please!
